entries.rationale: The candidate is option A. Orange and warm-gold source families including family-5976 and family-5094 reached the signature lane, but neither reached the complete-candidate accent-family set; the winner and retained slate therefore remain blue-green. The missing orange-gold identity described for both methods is a candidate accent-availability loss before complete-treatment Pareto ranking.

The candidate is option B. Green source families including family-7235, family-8117, and family-9020 reached complete accent candidates, but no green family survived into the retained accent slate; the selected treatment uses a brown accent. The missing green dome identity is therefore retained-slate underselection after candidate availability rather than source-family discovery failure.

The candidate is option B. Green family-7237 reached both complete accent candidates and the retained accent slate, while red family-5995 reached complete candidates; the deterministic winner nevertheless uses muted blue family-5489 as accent. The candidate was rated weak fallback and the baseline stronger, so the omitted green and red variety identifies top-treatment ranking underselection despite an identity-bearing green retained alternative.
